retroos-st-system.woff2 ("RetroOS ST System") is converted from the Atarist bitmap font by ntwk
(https://github.com/ntwk/atarist-font), a rebranding of the 8x16 high-resolution system font of the
Atari ST, extended with Cyrillic. The font is renamed so that its name contains no trademark.
Conversion: tools/fonts/bdf_font_to_woff2.py of Blazor.RetroOS.
